QuestInfo.name: A Gift for the Hero
QuestInfo.0: You should talk to #b#p1202005##k, standing on the road to town.
QuestInfo.1: #p1202005# wants to build a gift, but he's put all his supplies in different boxes. Break open boxes with regular attacks until you find a #b#t4032309##k and a regular #b#t4032310##k.
QuestInfo.2: You received a chair from #p1202005#. #p1202005# encouraged you by telling you that you are still a hero even though you've lost your powers.

item.0: Haven't you found the #b#t4032309##k and #b#t4032310##k yet? I stored those items in a box nearby, so all you'll need to do is break the box and bring back the items. You can break boxes by swinging at them like you're attacking a monster.
